summary: The filing is an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing routine monthly distributions paid by Franklin BSP Real Estate Debt, Inc. on seven classes of common stock. On July 14, 2026, the company paid gross distributions of $0.1900 per share for each class, with servicing fees deducted for two classes, in cash or reinvested under the distribution reinvestment plan. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special situation is involved. This is a standard current report of ordinary dividend payments with no strategic event. No further action or arbitrage opportunity exists.
